ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark grey/black) base with high-intensity (white) local features; approximate ratio 85:15.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white clusters at the distal tips; scattered white linear streaks across the central surfaces of both lobes; broken white margins along the superior trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow, wide U-shaped depression at the center of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular profile with frequent low-amplitude peaks and several distinct deep-pixel notches, most prominent on the left lobe superior margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward and outward sweep from the medial notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and irregular white clusters distributed across the dark field, appearing as localized high-contrast speckling.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of multi-directional, high-contrast white linear tracks (rake marks) overlaying the dark pigmentation on both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake mark scarring and significant irregular notches along the trailing edge boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Fragmented white fringe pattern tracing approximately 35% of the trailing edge perimeter.
